units.source_text: 事实上，在旁人的眼里，阿住和以前几乎毫无变化。

en.t: In fact, in other people's eyes, Osumi had hardly changed at all from before.

units.source_text: 倘若真要说出一点变化的话，那就是她不再像以前一样夸赞自己的儿媳妇阿民。

en.t: If one really had to point out a change, it was that she no longer praised her daughter-in-law Otami as she used to.

units.source_text: 不过，这种细微的变化，并未引起旁人的注意。

en.t: However, this slight change did not draw anyone else's attention.

units.source_text: 至少邻居家的阿婆和以往一样认为阿住是一个“来世积德”的人。

en.t: At least the old woman next door still thought of Osumi as someone who was storing up virtue for the next life.
